title: He mapped the genetics behind heart disease. In 2026, the American Heart Association gave him its top research honor.

sources.text: American Heart Association Newsroom - Cardiovascular genetics innovator to receive the 2026 Population Research Prize
American Bazaar - Indian-American cardiovascular genetics innovator wins 2026 Population Research Prize

caption:
He mapped the genetics behind heart disease. In 2026, the American Heart Association gave him its top research honor.

He will receive the award at the AHA's Scientific Sessions in Chicago on November 8, 2026. Natarajan is Vice President of Global Research and Head of Human Genetics at Amgen, while remaining a Professor of Medicine at Harvard Medical School and a Distinguished Physician at Massachusetts General Hospital.

His research uncovered genetic mechanisms behind lipid disorders, coronary artery disease and clonal hematopoiesis and advanced polygenic risk scores that help identify cardiovascular risk earlier. He has authored or co-authored more than 330 peer-reviewed publications and led an $11.2 million NIH-funded project on somatic mosaicism.

A Viksit Bharat by 2047 needs its scientists shaping the frontiers that matter most. Natarajan's work on predicting heart disease before it happens is exactly that kind of frontier.
